basis: flows F43, F58, F59 plus the discovery path
note:
**What a flash-sale environment runs, derived rather than chosen.** Weighted by how many times a single buyer calls each operation — two services carry most of the load and everything else is on the path without being the load.

**Services with `deployed: false` are shown deliberately.** A viewer that shows what is absent is more useful than one showing only what is present, and the absence is the point: six services see no part of a ticket sale.

routing.note: **Normal traffic and sale traffic are separate systems running concurrently.** The burst environment carries the on-sale and nothing else; everything a venue does that day continues in the shared cell. **They meet once, afterwards, at reconciliation.**

paths.name: normal
paths.exampleLoad: stadium, routine Saturday: 60,000 guests x 14 requests = 48.5 RPS
paths.description: **Everything except the sale.** Admission, food, retail, stock, staff back-office, reporting. Runs whether or not a sale is happening.

paths.name: sale
paths.exampleLoad: same stadium on-sale: 1.25M requests in 2h = 1,045 RPS at a 6x burst; compressed to 20 minutes, 6,270
paths.description: **The on-sale only.** Provisioned before it opens, torn down after, and **its orders reconcile back into the shared cell** (ADR-0035) — which is the single point the two paths touch.

meetingPoint.mechanism: environment id, monotonic sequence, idempotent replay, sync.rejection
meetingPoint.note: **The same three properties as `syncOrders` one layer up.** A till's offline journal and a burst environment's order log are the same problem at different scale.

replicas.maxNote: **No ceiling, deliberately.** A cap is a cap on absorbing a peak nobody predicted, and the peak is the whole reason this environment exists. 60,000 seats over two hours is 1,045 RPS; the same sale in twenty minutes is 6,270.
replicas.derivedFrom: 63.6% of 5000 RPS at 400 RPS per replica
replicas.realConstraint: Lease contention on acquireInventoryHold, not replica count. Measure it with tools/bench.py --pattern hot-venue.
